subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He did not succeed **despite of his hard work**.

options.text: in spite of his working hard

solution:
The correct answer is '**despite his hard work**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The word "**despite**" is used to express contrast or concession without the preposition "of." 
 
• The phrase "**despite his hard work**" is grammatically correct and concise.
